Question 9
?

Consider the path C shown above. Which of the following is equivalent to the line integral ∮C(sin⁡(cos⁡x)−x2y)dx+(xy2−1y+1)dy?

a
∫0π∫03r3drdθ
b
∫−π/2π/2∫03r3drdθ
c
∫−π/2π/2∫03rdrdθ
d
∫0π∫03rdrdθ
e
∫0π∫02(r+sin⁡(cos⁡θ))drdθ
